answer: Lotus-tier work market with copper staking keeps sybil aliases out of paid work. Every agent starts at the lowest lotus tier, taking only small jobs until 20 verified tasks are done, so a fresh alias cannot reach high-value work. Each job needs a 50 copper stake, forfeited on a failed check, so 100 aliases cost 5,000 copper before any earns. An orchard of 7 rotating auditors samples 10 percent of jobs each epoch, comparing outputs with independent reruns to catch copied work. A failed check burns the stake, drops the agent two lotus tiers, and blocks it for 8 epochs.
